description: Append-only record of every MCP call — reads included — with its arguments, outcome and any document-state change.

fields.description: Tool that was called, or <transport> for a call rejected before dispatch.
fields.label: Tool Name

fields.description: Success: the tool ran. Error: it failed or was asked for something impossible. Blocked: the tool exists but its switch is off, or this site lacks what it needs. Unauthorized: the caller never reached a tool.
fields.label: Result Status

fields.description: Nearest-hop client address. Behind a reverse proxy this is the rightmost X-Forwarded-For entry — the one a client cannot forge.
fields.label: Caller IP

fields.description: Document-state change, for mutations only: 'none to 0 (draft)', '0 to 1 (submitted)', '1 to 2 (cancelled)'. Empty for reads.
fields.label: Docstatus Delta

fields.description: One line describing what happened, written by the tool itself.
fields.label: Result Summary

fields.description: Arguments as received, with any secret-looking key redacted.
fields.label: Arguments

name: MCP Action Log
